description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI, which manages validation and processing of URI attributes according to RFC 3986 within the HTMLPurifier project. It includes methods for URI validation, creation, and handling of embedded resource flags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI
classes.description: A class that validates and processes URI attributes according to RFC 3986, supporting embedded resource handling and scheme-specific validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the URI parser and embedded resource flag based on input.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI, with embedded flag set if string equals 'embedded'.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given URI string against configuration and context, performing parsing, scheme validation, and filtering. Returns the string if valid, false otherwise.
